restaurantName: Zhang Lin A Shan Jiang Mu Ya
address: 65-6,7,8,9, Xinhua North Road, Licheng, Quanzhou, China Mainland
bio: Founded in 1999 under a different name, it has ever been popular with local ginger duck fans. On the right side of the entrance, row upon row of claypots make quite a spectacle. Muscovy duck is slow-cooked in rice wine with ginger and other herbs for two hours to build irresistible aromas. The duck is tender and falls off the bone and the broth is gingery, but not spicy. The soft, chewy pork blood sticky rice cake is also recommended....
pageTitle: Zhang Lin A Shan Jiang Mu Ya
